cases.name: landmarks-every-implementation-must-agree-on
cases.description: The values a reader can check by hand, and the ones a port gets wrong when it reaches for its host's library: log10(1000) is 3 and not 2.9999999999999996, which is exactly the defect a single smoke case per function let sit for months.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="m" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="C0"><gen if="log10(1000) == 3" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C1"><gen if="exp(0) == 1" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C2"><gen if="log(1) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C3"><gen if="sqrt(4) == 2" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C4"><gen if="cbrt(27) == 3" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C5"><gen if="hypot(3, 4) == 5" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C6"><gen if="pow(2, 10) == 1024" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C7"><gen if="log2(1024) == 10" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C8"><gen if="sin(0) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C9"><gen if="cos(0) == 1" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C10"><gen if="tan(0) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C11"><gen if="atan2(0, 1) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>log10_1000=${{C0}} exp0=${{C1}} log1=${{C2}} sqrt4=${{C3}} cbrt27=${{C4}} hypot=${{C5}} pow=${{C6}} log2=${{C7}} sin0=${{C8}} cos0=${{C9}} tan0=${{C10}} atan2=${{C11}}</data></line></block></tdc>
expected: log10_1000=ok exp0=ok log1=ok sqrt4=ok cbrt27=ok hypot=ok pow=ok log2=ok sin0=ok cos0=ok tan0=ok atan2=ok

cases.name: degrees-and-radians-are-each-others-inverse
cases.description: Round-tripping is where a port that keeps its own value of pi diverges in the last bit, and a comparison turns that into a different row.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="m" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="C0"><gen if="degrees(radians(180)) == 180" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C1"><gen if="degrees(radians(90)) == 90" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C2"><gen if="radians(0) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C3"><gen if="degrees(asin(1)) == 90" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C4"><gen if="acos(1) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C5"><gen if="atan(0) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>d180=${{C0}} d90=${{C1}} d0=${{C2}} asin1=${{C3}} acos1=${{C4}} atan0=${{C5}}</data></line></block></tdc>
expected: d180=ok d90=ok d0=ok asin1=ok acos1=ok atan0=ok

cases.name: rounding-is-half-away-from-zero-in-all-five
cases.description: The one rule hosts disagree about: JavaScript rounds -0.5 to -0, Python rounds 0.5 to 0 (banker's), and TDC does neither — it rounds half AWAY from zero, so 0.5 is 1 and -0.5 is -1.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="m" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="C0"><gen if="round(0.5) == 1" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C1"><gen if="round(-0.5) == -1" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C2"><gen if="round(1.5) == 2" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C3"><gen if="round(2.5) == 3" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C4"><gen if="round(-2.5) == -3" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>r05=${{C0}} rm05=${{C1}} r15=${{C2}} r25=${{C3}} rm25=${{C4}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: floor-ceil-and-trunc-part-company-on-negatives
cases.description: Positive numbers hide the difference entirely; a single smoke case per function would have used one.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="m" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="C0"><gen if="floor(-2.5) == -3" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C1"><gen if="ceil(-2.5) == -2" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C2"><gen if="trunc(-2.5) == -2" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C3"><gen if="floor(2.5) == 2" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C4"><gen if="ceil(2.5) == 3" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C5"><gen if="trunc(2.5) == 2" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C6"><gen if="abs(-2.5) == 2.5" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C7"><gen if="sign(-3) == -1" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C8"><gen if="sign(0) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>f=${{C0}} c=${{C1}} t=${{C2}} fp=${{C3}} cp=${{C4}} tp=${{C5}} abs=${{C6}} sgn=${{C7}} sgn0=${{C8}}</data></line></block></tdc>
expected: f=ok c=ok t=ok fp=ok cp=ok tp=ok abs=ok sgn=ok sgn0=ok

cases.name: hyperbolics-and-their-inverses-round-trip
cases.description: sinh/asinh and tanh/atanh are the pair most often implemented from a formula rather than from the host, and a formula loses accuracy near zero — which is where expm1 and log1p exist to fix it.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="m" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="C0"><gen if="sinh(0) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C1"><gen if="cosh(0) == 1" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C2"><gen if="tanh(0) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C3"><gen if="asinh(0) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C4"><gen if="acosh(1) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C5"><gen if="atanh(0) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C6"><gen if="expm1(0) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C7"><gen if="log1p(0) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>sinh0=${{C0}} cosh0=${{C1}} tanh0=${{C2}} asinh0=${{C3}} acosh1=${{C4}} atanh0=${{C5}} expm1=${{C6}} log1p=${{C7}}</data></line></block></tdc>
expected: sinh0=ok cosh0=ok tanh0=ok asinh0=ok acosh1=ok atanh0=ok expm1=ok log1p=ok

cases.name: the-special-functions-at-the-points-they-are-defined-by
cases.description: erf(0), gamma(1) and gamma(5) are the values these are DEFINED by rather than approximated at, so a port whose series is subtly wrong still passes a smoke test and fails here.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="m" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="C0"><gen if="erf(0) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C1"><gen if="erfc(0) == 1" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C2"><gen if="gamma(1) == 1" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C3"><gen if="gamma(5) == 24" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C4"><gen if="lgamma(1) == 0" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C5"><gen if="beta(1, 1) == 1" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>erf0=${{C0}} erfc0=${{C1}} gamma1=${{C2}} gamma5=${{C3}} lgamma1=${{C4}} beta=${{C5}}</data></line></block></tdc>
expected: erf0=ok erfc0=ok gamma1=ok gamma5=ok lgamma1=ok beta=ok

cases.name: min-and-max-take-as-many-arguments-as-they-are-given
cases.description: Two is the case everybody writes; five is where an implementation that folds pairwise in the wrong order shows itself, and the mixed signs are where a comparison on strings would pass by accident.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="m" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="C0"><gen if="min(3, 7) == 3" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C1"><gen if="max(3, 7) == 7" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C2"><gen if="min(9, 2, 7, 4, 5) == 2" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C3"><gen if="max(9, 2, 7, 4, 5) == 9" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C4"><gen if="min(-3, -7) == -7" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C5"><gen if="max(-3, -7) == -3" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C6"><gen if="min(10, -2) == -2" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C7"><gen if="max(2, 10) == 10" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>min2=${{C0}} max2=${{C1}} min5=${{C2}} max5=${{C3}} minneg=${{C4}} maxneg=${{C5}} minmix=${{C6}} maxstr=${{C7}}</data></line></block></tdc>
expected: min2=ok max2=ok min5=ok max5=ok minneg=ok maxneg=ok minmix=ok maxstr=ok

cases.name: whole-numbers-stay-whole-past-two-to-the-fifty-three
cases.description: On doubles 9007199254740993 and 9007199254740992 are the same number and their difference is zero — both wrong, and wrong in silence. Arithmetic held the integer domain from the start; abs, round, floor, ceil, trunc and max did NOT — each took its argument through a double and handed back a neighbour of the number it was given. Found by this case on the day it was written, which is the argument for writing many of them: one smoke case per function had reported all six as covered.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="m" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="C0"><gen if="9007199254740993 != 9007199254740992" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C1"><gen if="9007199254740993 - 9007199254740992 == 1" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C2"><gen if="9007199254740993 > 9007199254740992" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C3"><gen if="3037000499 * 3037000499 == 9223372030926249001" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C4"><gen if="abs(-9007199254740993) == 9007199254740993" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>ne=${{C0}} diff=${{C1}} big=${{C2}} mul=${{C3}} abs=${{C4}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: functions-nest-and-compose
cases.description: Each of these is two or three functions deep, which is how they are actually written and never how they are tested. round rather than trunc on exp(log(7)): the round trip lands on 6.999999999999999, which is floating point being honest — truncating it to 6 would be right, and pinning 7 there would pin a lie.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="m" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="C0"><gen if="round(sqrt(2) * 1000) == 1414" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C1"><gen if="floor(log10(999)) == 2" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C2"><gen if="max(abs(-5), min(3, 9)) == 5" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C3"><gen if="round(exp(log(7))) == 7" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C4"><gen if="round(degrees(atan2(1, 1))) == 45" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C5"><gen if="ceil(hypot(1, 1)) == 2" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>a=${{C0}} b=${{C1}} c=${{C2}} d=${{C3}} e=${{C4}} f=${{C5}}</data></line></block></tdc>
expected: a=ok b=ok c=ok d=ok e=ok f=ok

cases.name: string-predicates-at-their-edges
cases.description: The empty needle, the whole haystack, and case — each of which a host library answers differently, and each of which reads as a plausible row when it is wrong. The empty needle is true for contains, starts_with and ends_with alike — every string ends with nothing — and a port that answers false there is wrong in a way nobody would notice.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="m" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="C0"><gen if="contains('hello', 'ell')" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C1"><gen if="!contains('hello', 'ELL')" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C2"><gen if="starts_with('hello', 'he')" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C3"><gen if="!starts_with('hello', 'He')" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C4"><gen if="ends_with('hello', 'lo')" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C5"><gen if="ends_with('hello', '')" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C6"><gen if="lower('HeLLo') == 'hello'" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C7"><gen if="upper('HeLLo') == 'HELLO'" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C8"><gen if="is_empty('')" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence><sequence name="C9"><gen if="!is_empty(' ')" type="text" value="ok"/><gen type="text" value="WRONG"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>c1=${{C0}} c2=${{C1}} s1=${{C2}} s2=${{C3}} e1=${{C4}} e2=${{C5}} l=${{C6}} u=${{C7}} emp=${{C8}} nemp=${{C9}}</data></line></block></tdc>
expected: c1=ok c2=ok s1=ok s2=ok e1=ok e2=ok l=ok u=ok emp=ok nemp=ok
